conventions: Every path is relative to this directory. Each fixture is a bundle.
A null number stands for NaN. No fixture holds an infinity.
min, max, count, and the integer values compare exactly. mean and var compare within 2^-20 relative.
period_us of a level is the value of the level attribute, and samples_per_bin is the width s_k of section 4.3.
columns lists the per-event columns of an event channel other than events, in the order of section 5.1.
recording_json is the content of recording.json, or null when the bundle has none.
findings lists what full validation reports, as a path, a section, and a fragment of the message. A conforming bundle has none.
reader_must_reject marks a bundle that section 8.2 requires a reader to reject. A reader may accept the other invalid bundles.

continuous_30khz.exercises: A channel at 30000 Hz, where the period of a level is not a whole number of microseconds. The last bin of levels 3 through 6 holds fewer samples than the width of its level.

continuous_24414hz.exercises: A channel at 24414.0625 Hz, a rate that is exact in binary and has a sample period of 40.96 microseconds. The last bin of levels 2 through 6 holds fewer samples than the width of its level.

continuous_runs.exercises: A channel of three runs at 1000 Hz. A pause of 700 samples between the first two leaves NaN samples, so bins of levels 1 and 2 hold count 0 and one bin holds a partial count. The second run starts 0.4 sample periods off the grid. The third run starts 0.05 sample periods after the end of the second, which leaves no NaN sample.

continuous_dropout.exercises: A channel of 4096 samples at 1000 Hz with one NaN sample at index 1234. The sample leaves count one below the width in the bin that holds it at each of the 6 levels, and enters no minimum, maximum, or mean.

continuous_dc_offset.exercises: A channel of 4096 samples at 1000 Hz with mean 1e4 and standard deviation 5, whose levels hold var. A variance folded from float32 means loses its precision at this offset.

continuous_empty.exercises: A continuous channel with N = 0: raw has shape (0,), and the channel holds no runs and no levels.

events_empty.exercises: An event channel with n = 0 that holds every optional column except a count level. Each column has 0 rows, text has width 1, channels has 1 byte, and waveform_mean holds L = 2 rows of NaN.

events_all_columns.exercises: An event channel at index 9 of a bundle of 10 channels, so channels is 2 bytes wide. It holds durations below a loose max_duration_us, a tie in the event times, labels 0 and 1 of 3 label_names, values, text with multi-byte UTF-8, an empty text, and a text as wide as the column, channels with a row that names no channel and a row with the last valid bit set, waveforms and waveform_mean with a label that has no event and a sample with no finite value, and 3 count levels whose offset_us is negative. recording.json holds a reference_time and a session start_time in another zone.

extension_1_1.exercises: A bundle that declares version 1.1 and holds what a later minor release may add: an unknown tsz key on the root, a channel, a level, and an event channel, an unknown group under a channel, an unknown member of a level, an unknown column of an event channel, an unknown node under the root, an unknown key in recording.json, and two unknown files. A 1.0 reader reads it and ignores them. A validator reports the minor version as unsupported and nothing else.

device.model: a key that 1.0 does not define

invalid/no_consolidated_metadata.exercises: A root zarr.json without consolidated_metadata, which is not a bundle. A reader rejects it.

invalid/missing_events_chunk.exercises: An event channel of 8 events whose events array has no chunk. Section 7.3 requires every chunk of a per-event column.

invalid/event_time_past_limit.exercises: An event at 2^53 microseconds, which section 2.3 excludes. The writer refuses such a time, so the bundle is built by hand.
